summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by PayPay Corporation reporting voting results from its 8th Annual General Meeting of Shareholders held on June 29, 2026. The sole proposal was the election of five directors, each approved with over 99% of votes cast in favor. No special-situation event—merger, tender offer, restructuring, or activist campaign—is disclosed. The filing fulfills Japanese reporting obligations under the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act and is translated into English for SEC purposes. Nothing in the document suggests a material corporate event requiring special-situations classification.
